info.name: PayU Hosted Checkout (Non-seamless Integration)
info.description: API specification for PayU Hosted Checkout where payment method selection and card details are captured on PayU's side.

urlencoded.description: (Required) Merchant key provided by PayU during onboarding.
(Required) The transaction ID is a reference number for a specific order that is generated by the merchant.
(Required) The payment amount for the transaction.
(Required) A brief description of the product.
(Required) The first name of the customer.
(Required) The success URL, which is the page PayU will redirect to if the transaction is successful.
(Required) The Failure URL, which is the page PayU will redirect to if the transaction is failed.
(Required) The email address of the customer.
(Required) It is the hash calculated by the merchant. The format for calculating the hash: sha512(key|txnid|amount|productinfo|firstname|email|udf1|udf2|udf3|udf4|udf5||||||SALT)
The phone number of the customer.
The last name of the customer.
This parameter is used to identify whether it is a B2B transaction. If 1 is posted, it is a B2B transaction.
The Cancel URL, which is the page PayU will redirect to if the transaction is cancelled by customer.
User-defined fields (udf) are used to store any information corresponding to a particular transaction. You can use up to five udfs in the post designated as udf1, udf2, udf3, udf4, udf5.

urlencoded.value: I declare that the remittance is within my annual LRS limit
urlencoded.description: Mandatory declaration for Liberalised Remittance Scheme limit. NOTE: This value will be displayed on the PayU Checkout page (non-seamless) before collecting the payment details. This parameter is mandatory for Cross Border LRS transactions.

urlencoded.value: I agree to the terms and conditions for LRS transactions
urlencoded.description: Terms and conditions for Liberalised Remittance Scheme. NOTE: This value will be displayed on the PayU Checkout page (non-seamless) before collecting the payment details. This parameter is mandatory for Cross Border LRS transactions.

urlencoded.value: I declare that this transaction is under the specified limit
urlencoded.description: Declaration for Tax Collected at Source under LRS limit. NOTE: This value will be displayed on the PayU Checkout page (non-seamless). This is an optional parameter.
The LRS service type decides the tax amount based on the nature of business. For more information, refer to the Additional Info for Parameters table.
